subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for macOS Computer Use discovery and app-owned permission binding decisions?
rationale: The requested contract is additive, but it creates plugin-author API surface and affects a trust boundary around Accessibility and Screen Recording metadata before runtime load.

options.title: Accept after owner confirmation
options.body: Confirm the field names, metadata shape, and discovery-only permission semantics in the linked PR before merging it.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Rename, narrow, or restructure the provider metadata before freezing it as a public plugin manifest contract.

options.title: Pause until host design settles
options.body: Leave the issue and PR open or reject the direction until the macOS host binding model is firmer.

recommendation.title: Accept after owner confirmation
recommendation.body: Confirm the field names, metadata shape, and discovery-only permission semantics in the linked PR before merging it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history-backed owner for plugin manifest metadata and docs surfaces and is the best available routing candidate for the API/security-boundary decision.
